reason: The hypothesis directly combines the well-documented effect of grain refinement on oxidation resistance (from P5, P11, P19, P21, P26) with the equally well-known role of Al and Cr in forming protective duplex scales (from P1, P6, P8, P12, P16, P17, P22, P25). The proposed mechanism—that controlled, slow outward diffusion of Al and Cr, facilitated by a refined microstructure, forms a continuous duplex oxide—is a straightforward restatement of conclusions already drawn in P21 and P26. No new alloy system, regime, or mechanistic link is introduced; the hypothesis merely synthesizes two established findings into a single, generic prediction without resolving any conflict or gap in the cited literature.
